description: Repo-local watch config for tools/harness_watch.py. One injected entry per harness: what its FIRST-PARTY docs must still say about skill discovery, and what our adapter currently assumes. When a harness ships a new version and its docs drift from `expect`, the checker flags it so we can re-verify and, if needed, change the adapter's approach. Nothing about any harness is hard-coded in the script — it iterates this config. Update `verified_on` and the `expect` rules here (never in the script) whenever a harness is re-reviewed.

trees.shared: reads the open agentskills.io tree .agents/skills/ — skills go there via emit_shared_skills (one byte-identical copy across all shared harnesses)
trees.native: reads its own <root>/skills/ — skills rendered in the harness dialect
trees.commands: opencode-only: the fourteen ship as /-invoked .opencode/commands/*.md, not skills (its skills are auto-invoked and have no disable-model-invocation)

claude-code.note: Claude Code's own skills tree; not on the open .agents/skills standard here.

opencode.note: Ships as commands, not skills, because opencode skills are auto-invoked with no disable-model-invocation key. If `disable-model-invocation` ever appears in the docs, revisit shipping the fourteen as skills.

codex.note: Reads ONLY the open .agents/skills tree (never .codex/skills); crew stay Codex-native at .codex/agents/*.toml. If the docs start naming .codex/skills, re-check.

cursor.note: Reads BOTH .agents/skills and .cursor/skills, but only .cursor/skills reaches the slash-command picker (#405), so we ship there — one copy, never both. Also watch: `.cursor/agents` subagent schema is still undocumented — if it lands, cursor could become crew-bearing (harness_matrix agents=false).

github-copilot.note: Accepts .github/skills, .claude/skills AND .agents/skills; we use the shared .agents/skills. Crew are .github/agents/*.agent.md (personas).

antigravity.note: agy reads .agents/ throughout: skills at .agents/skills (shared), crew at .agents/agents/*.md. The docs page (antigravity.google) is a JS-rendered app, so its content is not in the static HTML — check=reachable confirms it still loads and flags it for manual review rather than false-flagging every run.

pi.note: Reads the open .agents/skills tree natively; this entry watches the SKILLS tree only, and that path is unchanged. The crew are separate and pi-native: the third-party `pi-subagents` extension reads `.pi/agents/<name>.md` (project) and `~/.pi/agent/agents/` (user), and still reads the legacy `.agents/**` tree — see capability_registry.json and harness_matrix.json.

grok-build.note: Native .grok tree, not the shared .agents one: the seventeen commands ship disable-model-invocation, which the neutral two-key rendering would drop. Grok also scans .agents/.claude trees but resolves .grok first. If the docs URL stops resolving the strings, switch to check: reachable rather than invent a path.

devin.note: Renamed from `windsurf` on 2026-09-22 (Windsurf became Devin Desktop 2026-06-02; Cascade was replaced by Devin Local, which spawns subagents). Devin documents THREE skill trees - `.agents/skills/` (recommended, shared), `.devin/skills/` (native, precedence) and `.windsurf/skills/` (legacy, still read) - and we ship the native one because the seventeen commands must stay user-invoked only and the guard is the vendor key `triggers: [user]`, which the neutral shared rendering would drop. Crew are `.devin/agents/<name>.md`. If the `triggers` key disappears from this page, re-check before trusting the guard.
